headline: Norris wins a wet Interlagos as Verstappen charges from 21st to second and Mercedes seal the constructors' title, Cadillac take Monza while Toyota's #8 crew clinch the WEC crown, and GTA 6 preloads tomorrow.

SpaceX Starship Flight 15 target date, going for ship and booster catches (time TBC)

items.headline: Norris wins a wet São Paulo GP from pole
items.summary: Lando Norris controlled a race that started wet and dried before a late shower, ahead of Max Verstappen, who climbed from 21st on the grid, and Isack Hadjar for a Red Bull double podium. Hamilton came home 9th from 20th in his 400th start.

items.headline: Mercedes are 2026 constructors' champions
items.summary: Russell (4th) and Antonelli (5th, after a couple of spins) scored enough to put the title out of Ferrari's reach, adding to Antonelli's drivers' crown from Mexico.

items.headline: WEC Monza: Cadillac win, Toyota #8 take the drivers' title
items.summary: The #38 Cadillac won the 6 Hours of Monza, while the #8 Toyota crew did enough to clinch the 2026 drivers' championship. TF Sport sealed the LMGT3 title.

items.headline: UFC 334 fight week: Gane vs Hokit at MSG
items.summary: Ciryl Gane defends the heavyweight title against Josh Hokit on Saturday, with Kayla Harrison vs Amanda Nunes as co-main. Expect media day and weigh-in storylines all week; main card around 03:00 Sunday Irish time.

items.headline: Quiet Sunday for tech news
items.summary: No major launches overnight. For the week's AI round-up (OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia), this daily digest covers today's moves as they land.

items.headline: Starship Flight 15 slips a day to Friday the 13th
items.summary: SpaceX now targets 13 November for the next Starship test, aiming to catch both the Super Heavy booster and, for the first time, the ship itself.

items.headline: Sky watch: Leonids peak next week
items.summary: The Leonid meteor shower peaks in the early hours of Wednesday 18 November; head out after 01:00 for the best rates if skies clear.

items.headline: GTA 6 preload opens tomorrow
items.summary: Rockstar confirmed the console preload starts 10 November, with a download of up to 212 GB, ahead of the 19 November launch. Clear some space tonight.

items.headline: Watchlist: nothing new
items.summary: No fresh news on The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 or Borderlands since Friday.

items.headline: IBJJF The Crown 2026: results coming in
items.summary: The Crown ran overnight in the US, with Mica Galvão back in action. Full results weren't confirmed in time for this brief; FloGrappling's live page has every match.
